sample_mapping_evidence: 16 pancreatic cancer PBMC donors and4 healthy donors.10A/10B are same-patient technical processing at two core facilities; retain10A only after shared-barcode/expression audit. Tissue specimens excluded.

source_metadata.access: Public processed count matrices; controlled raw sequence not required
source_metadata.gene_identifier_type: Ensembl IDs and source symbols; source hg19/GRCh37 reference

replicate_review.decision: Retain capture10A only for this specimen;10B is technical same-donor record with many shared barcodes, avoid potentially duplicating cells. No additional biological sample count.

title: PDAC_PBMC_1
extract_protocol_ch1: Tissues  were  mechanically  minced  and  enzymatically  digested  with  collagenase  P (1mg/mL DMEM) and subsequently filtered through a 40µm mesh to obtain single cells. Dead cells were removed using MACS®Dead Cell Removal Kit (Miltenyi Biotec Inc.).
Single-cell cDNA libraries were  prepared  and sequenced using  the  10x Genomics  Platform
data_processing: Samples were run using paired end 50 cycle reads on HiSeq 4000 or the NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina) to a depth of 100,000 reads.

The raw data were processed and aligned by the University of Michigan DNA Sequencing Core. Cellranger count version 3.0.0 with default settings was used, with an initial expected cell count of 10,000. In all casesthe hg19 reference supplied with the cellranger software was used for alignment.
Genome_build: Genome Reference Consortium Human Build 37 (GRCh37)
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Zipped .tar containing .mtx.gz, and .tsv.gz files for reading into R using the Seurat Pipeline
